title: Pinned messages
summary: Pinned messages of a group (bipe-chat/bipe#665): a banner above the timeline with the newest pin, a list of all pins, and Fixar and Desafixar in the message menu. Groups only (ADR 0141: DMs have no pins).

senderName.description: The sender's display name, bipe_app_you for the own user.

text.description: The message body, the media caption or the media kind label, one line.

pins.description: From Room.timelineWithConfiguration with focus pinnedEvents, newest pin first. Events the phone cannot show are left out.

shownIndex.description: The pin the banner shows, 0 is the newest.

showsList.description: true while the list sheet shows.

tapBanner.effect: Scrolls the chat to the shown pin (chat-timeline openOriginal), then shownIndex moves to the next older pin, and from the oldest back to the newest.

openList.effect: bipe_pinned_view_all on the banner: a sheet titled bipe_pinned_list_title with every pin. A tap closes it and scrolls to the message.

pin.effect: message-actions row bipe_pin_action on a sent message of a group when canPin and the event is not pinned: Timeline.pinEvent. A failure shows bipe_error_generic.

unpin.effect: message-actions row bipe_unpin_action when canPin and the event is pinned (RoomInfo.pinnedEventIds), from the menu or the list: Timeline.unpinEvent.

notes: The banner shows bipe_pinned_banner_title, or bipe_pinned_banner_count (%1$s the place of the shown pin from the newest, %2$s the number of pins) with two or more, the sender and the text. No pins: no banner.

Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#665): the pin list opens from the banner only, not from group-details, because a tap in the list scrolls the chat, and group-details sits over the chat. mz can overrule.
